start.speaker: The Widow
start.text: It died and you died. Only one of you was owed anything, and it was not the one with the crown.

r2.speaker: The Widow
r2.text: Four floors down is where my husband stopped. You went past him and came back. I am not going to thank you for that.

r3.speaker: The Widow
r3.text: You came up the stair whole. I sit at the bottom of it every evening and that has happened four times.

r4.speaker: The Widow
r4.text: The chapel. The socket above the altar is warm. It has been warm for eleven years and there is nothing in it.

r5.speaker: The Widow
r5.text: Ten. I know the count. I have always known the count. It is the only thing anybody leaves with me.

quiet.speaker: The Widow
quiet.text: Sit if you like. I am at the bottom of the stair either way.
